scope: Digital Twin calibration and held-out validation data contract; no observed data is bundled

data_availability.reason: No immutable observed dispatch outcomes with the required state, action, timing, and outcome fields are available under the authorized local data root.
data_availability.unlock_condition: Register an authorized observed-outcome manifest with non-overlapping calibration and held-out identities before calibration or validation execution.

split_rationale.ordering: Earlier contiguous observation windows are calibration; later windows are held-out, with scenario strata present in both only when independently observed.
split_rationale.reason: Temporal ordering limits future leakage while scenario strata prevent a single easy regime from defining Twin fidelity. Geographic checks remain mandatory when location fields exist.

calibration.selection: authorized observed outcomes in the preregistered calibration time window

held_out.selection: authorized observed outcomes in a later, disjoint held-out time window
